message.content:
This appears to be a CBP ruling on organic coconut cream, which I recall being classified in subheading 2106.90. Coconut cream (coconut extract and water) is not a fruit juice under chapter 20 because coconut is not a juice in that sense. Coconut milk and cream have been classified in 2106.90 as food preparations not elsewhere specified, with the 10-digit number depending on sugar content and other factors.

Alternatives I considered:
- 2008.19 (nuts prepared or preserved) does not fit, since the product is an extract rather than whole or pieces of nut.
- 2009.89 (juice of any other single fruit) was considered. CBP has ruled on coconut milk in 2106.90.99 in some cases and in 2008.99 in others. I recall that unsweetened coconut milk was classified in 2106.90.99.
- For a product that is about 89 percent coconut extract and 11 percent water, the likely answer is 2106.90.9998 (other food preparations, not elsewhere specified, other, other).

The 2106.90.99 subheading breaks out into 2106.90.9900 variants, and I believe the 10-digit code used for this kind of ruling is 2106.90.9998. I am reasonably but not fully certain of this.

{"hts_code": "2106.90.9998", "reason": "Coconut cream (about 89% coconut extract and 11% water) sold as an industrial ingredient is a food preparation not elsewhere specified or included, so it falls in 2106.90.9998."}
